## Checklist

- [ ] One-sentence description, neutral language, no marketing copy.
- [ ] Project is open source or has a genuinely usable free local tier.
- [ ] Project runs locally on user-owned hardware.
- [ ] Actively maintained (commit in the last ~6 months) or feature-complete.
- [ ] Link checker and markdownlint pass.
